cues: The wave velocity is a fixed property of the medium.
Differentiating with respect to x instead gives the slope of the wave, and the two are linked: particle velocity equals minus v times the slope.
text: So never mix them up. The particle velocity keeps changing. The wave velocity is a fixed property of the medium. Differentiating with respect to x instead gives the slope of the wave, and the two are linked: particle velocity equals minus v times the slope.
